subject: Architecture
title: Neoclassical: Greece Reborn in the 1700s
description: Learn Neoclassical: Greece Reborn in the 1700s in one minute.

hook.text: In the 1700s, Europe rediscovered Pompeii and fell madly in love with ancient architecture again.

buildup.text: Architects traveled to Rome and Athens to sketch ruins, then built new versions back home.

discovery.text: Neoclassicism was about order, symmetry, and reason — the Enlightenment expressed in stone.

twist.text: Revolutionary governments loved it. Both America and France adopted it as the style of democracy.

climax.text: The U.S. Capitol, the British Museum, and the Bolshoi Theatre are all Neoclassical buildings.

punchline.text: New democracies dressed in old Greece to look legitimate.

quiz.question: What discovery helped spark the Neoclassical movement?
options: The excavation of Pompeii and ancient ruins
